descriptionChirho: A noun denoting an object of trembling or horror, used exclusively in prophetic judgment oracles to describe the terrifying fate of nations or peoples whom YHWH has given over to destruction. Always occurs with preposition le- (to/for/as), indicating the condition into which the subject is cast. Attested in Deuteronomy's covenant curses (Deut 28:25), Jeremiah's repeated judgment formulae (Jer 15:4; 24:9; 24:17; 29:18; 34:17), and Ezekiel's oracle against Tyre (Ezek 23:46). Cognate with the root z-w-' (to tremble).
